sections.name: File setup, ComplianceModule
sections.title: Compliance feature packaging
sections.what: Lists the database, authentication and storage modules as needed, registers the compliance controller and service, and exports the service.
sections.why: Likely reason: standard NestJS grouping so the feature loads as one unit.
sections.watch_out: The service needs the file storage module to delete stored files, so removing that import would stop file deletion from working.

summary: Packages the compliance feature so the app can load its controller and service with access to the database, login checks and file storage.
purpose: Tells NestJS which controller and service belong to compliance and which modules they need.
why: Likely reason: standard NestJS grouping of a feature.
how: 1. Imports the database, authentication and storage modules. 2. Registers the compliance controller and service. 3. Exports the service.
outputs: A module object loaded at startup.
risks: If any imported module is missing or misnamed, the app will fail at startup. Nothing here limits who can call the feature beyond what the controller applies.
debug: Look for a startup error naming a missing provider or module, and check the import paths.
